name: vora-js
description: npm workspace for the Vora JavaScript/TypeScript packages

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run build --workspace @vorash/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorash/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @vorash/sdk && npm run test --workspace @vorash/mcp
